tasks.short: Align online retail plans with physical or catalogue channels.

steps.what: Collect channel sales, stock, promotion and fulfilment data into a comparison workbook.
Reconcile product codes, reporting periods, returns and channel cost definitions.
Calculate margin, stock allocation and promotion scenarios using agreed assumptions.
Choose a channel proposal considering customer behaviour, brand positioning and commercial uncertainty.
Agree channel responsibilities, operational constraints and trade-offs with channel and operations managers.
Approve channel priorities, budget limits and the proposed commercial tests.
Record approved actions, owners and deadlines in the shared delivery plan.
Review channel results and flag deviations requiring a revised proposal.

tasks.design: An integration on the {DATA_PLATFORM} reconciles {ECOMMERCE}, {ERP} and {OPS_SYSTEM} data, with explicit mapping exceptions and a deterministic scenario generator. The online merchant develops the proposal and negotiates trade-offs; the marketing manager approves commercial commitments. Configured flows in the {PROJECT} create actions from the approved plan, while the {BI} tracks results.
tasks.previous_blocker: Channel definitions and product codes differ. Comparable margin figures require manual reconciliation, while channel priorities require agreement across teams.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing exports and interfaces support scheduled reconciliation and scenario calculations. AI-assisted coding can reduce implementation effort without changing the underlying commercial uncertainty.
tasks.still_hard: Allocating shared costs, estimating channel substitution and resolving competing incentives remain difficult. External retail partners may provide incomplete or delayed data.
tasks.human_edge: Understand channel politics, assess uncertain customer behaviour and negotiate a commercially credible compromise.

ambition.what: Weekly selection of a cross-channel stock allocation experiment.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from assembling channel comparisons toward evaluating experiments and resolving trade-offs. With explicit delegation, the merchant could select experiments within approved stock and budget limits; wider budget authority stays with the marketing manager.

reach.learn: Contribution margin, incrementality and the limits of channel attribution.

reach.task: Design a test of channel substitution.
reach.learn: Comparison groups, seasonality and uncertainty in small samples.

evidence.claim: Structured channel reconciliation, scenario calculation and reporting can use deterministic integrations and dashboards.
Cross-channel strategy still requires human commercial judgement and coordination.
The proposed time shares, remaining effort and build ranges are planning estimates, not measured outcomes.

assumptions: The online business coordinates with a physical or catalogue channel, directly or through a retail partner.
Core sales and stock records already reside in systems; a workbook bridges channel reporting.
The target solution uses aggregated commercial data and does not introduce employee monitoring.
Build ranges cover one channel comparison workflow and an initial set of agreed scenarios.
Consent and access time includes access approval and any applicable consultation under national rules; formal proceedings may take longer.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply where relevant; this design does not require model-based customer or worker scoring.
unknowns: Which physical or catalogue channels exist and who controls them.
Whether channel interfaces, exports and historical cost data are accessible.
Who can approve product mappings, cost definitions and commercial commitments.
Whether shared customer identifiers or employee-level data enter current reports.
Which national consultation requirements and internal approval processes apply.
research_questions: Can existing reporting configuration produce a sufficiently consistent channel comparison before custom integration is built?
Which scenario assumptions most affect the decision, and how can they be tested?
Can aggregate channel data answer the commercial question without linking customer identities?
new_work: Review unmapped products, missing feeds and unexplained reconciliation differences.
Maintain cost definitions and scenario assumptions when commercial arrangements change.
Check whether experiments measure incremental value or merely move sales between channels.
Maintain connector access and investigate failed refreshes.

tasks.short: Create, approve and distribute printed promotional materials.

steps.what: Define the audience, offer, format, distribution route and print quantity.
Collect approved product facts, prices, images, offer terms and brand assets.
Write headlines, product copy and calls to action for the selected format.

loop.input: Print brief, approved product facts, offer terms and brand writing rules.
loop.output: Promotional copy draft with references to supplied facts.
loop.check: Validate prices, dates, links and length against source fields; flag unsupported claims for human correction.
loop.stop: One draft and at most one repair pass; missing facts or failed checks return to the merchant.
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed wording covers routine stationery, but campaign headlines and persuasive copy vary with audience and offer.

steps.what: Lay out artwork in desktop publishing software using brand assets and printer specifications.
Check the proof and approve claims, prices, terms and visual presentation.
Send approved artwork and confirm the supplier quote, quantity and delivery instructions.
Inspect delivered print samples and resolve quantity, colour or finishing defects.
Insert materials into parcels or place them at agreed promotional locations.

tasks.design: A deterministic generator assembles approved facts from the {ECOMMERCE} and assets from the {DOCS}, then produces artwork from controlled templates. A bounded model loop drafts variable campaign copy, while people approve the proof and print commitment through the {WORKFLOW} and {PROCUREMENT}. Distribution instructions feed the {OPS_SYSTEM}; people inspect and handle the physical materials.
tasks.previous_blocker: Facts, images and offer terms are scattered across records and files. Repeated layout work and supplier correspondence persist even when the creative format changes little.
tasks.enabler_now: Template rendering, print-file validation and approval flows are established capabilities. Bounded text drafting and faster custom coding make it cheaper to connect them for smaller print runs.
tasks.still_hard: Original creative direction, unusual formats, image rights and physical print quality need judgement. Printed errors cannot be corrected remotely after distribution.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a message that fits the audience, recognise misleading implications and judge whether physical materials communicate well.

ambition.what: Small-batch promotional packs for collection-point partners.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from repeated copy and layout production toward campaign briefs, proof decisions and distribution experiments. Approval rights remain unchanged unless the organisation explicitly delegates a print budget.

reach.learn: Typography, bleed, colour handling, image resolution and printer specifications.

reach.task: Check promotional proofs against approved source facts.
reach.learn: Offer consistency, claim substantiation and systematic proof correction.

evidence.claim: Product-description drafting is available today; this supports the copy step, not print production or distribution.
Controlled templates can generate recurring print layouts and validate dimensions, required fields and text overflow.
Physical print inspection and distribution generally retain human work without additional handling equipment.
The proposed time shares, remaining effort and build ranges are planning estimates, not measured outcomes.

assumptions: Most recurring materials fit a small family of approved templates; bespoke creative campaigns remain separate.
Today's task time includes merchant, design, approval and distribution labour, excluding supplier production time.
Supplier quotes and print costs require approval before an order is sent.
The initial scope uses generic parcel inserts and signage rather than personally addressed mail.
Run cost excludes printing, postage and physical handling.
Access estimates include asset permissions and supplier setup; employee consultation under national rules applies if the implementation changes working practices in scope.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply where relevant; any later use of recipient lists needs a separate data-use assessment.
unknowns: Which materials recur often enough to justify templates.
Whether product images, fonts and brand assets are licensed for the intended print use.
Who approves claims, artwork, supplier costs and distribution quantities.
Which printer specifications and submission routes are required.
Whether distribution uses personal recipient data.
Whether collection-point partners exist and would use promotional packs.
research_questions: Can existing desktop publishing configuration generate the recurring formats before a custom renderer is built?
Which factual checks can be enforced automatically before proof approval?
What sample print run is sufficient to validate templates and physical quality?
new_work: Maintain templates, printer specifications and brand assets.
Review drafted copy and resolve unsupported claims or missing source facts.
Revalidate prices and offer dates immediately before print release.
Investigate print defects and withdraw outdated material.
Maintain supplier connections and approved distribution instructions.

role.altitude: The merchant spends less time assembling comparisons and producing repeated artwork. More time goes to channel experiments, creative direction and commercial coordination; new spending or strategy rights require explicit delegation.
reach: Marketing managers: prepare and evaluate cross-channel commercial experiments.
Market research analysts: measure incremental channel effects.
Graphic designers: maintain reusable print formats and assess proofs.
role.ambitious_version: Run a regular cross-channel experiment programme, supported by consistent commercial data and small-batch promotional materials, with authority to choose tests inside an agreed budget.
